Thirty zeros need 29 gaps. The smallest total starts and ends on a small gap, giving 15 small and 14 large gaps: 15·(2π/3) + 14·(4π/3) = 86π/3 in θ. Halving for x gives b − a = 43π/3, which is less than 15π.

The interval [a, b] can start exactly at a zero and end at a zero, so 43π/3 is attained. The submitted 15π is not the minimum.
